subject: Re: Renewal + proposal: slice reservation optimization for HelioAI
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helioai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: recommended reserved slice profile for Q3/Q4

Hi Sarah —

Hope you’re doing well. As we approach HelioAI’s August renewal date, I pulled a usage view for the Q2 period and sketched a small proposal that should lower unit costs while preserving the burst headroom you asked for. Key observations from Q2: 

- Average sustained GPU utilization across your production models: ~62% (4wk moving)
- Peak day windows (24-48h) where usage spikes to ~95% ~6x per quarter
- Prefix caching and KV reuse reduced token compute for repetitive inferencing by ~12%

Recommendation (high level): convert ~40 of your current burst GPUs to reserved slices with a 12-month term, keep ~20 GPUs as on-demand burst to handle transient peaks, and schedule a quarterly utilization review so we can reprofile before heavy marketing events. Estimated impact: ~25% reduction in monthly unit cost vs pure burst-only pattern.

I attached the Q2 usage CSV and a proposed reserved slice schedule. Ben and I can walk through pricing and timing next week — are you available Tue 20 Jul between 10–12 PT?

If that sounds reasonable I’ll draft a short addendum and route to procurement.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0173
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HelioAI_Q2_usage_report.csv (CSV), Proposed_reserved_slices_schedule_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helioai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@helioai.com>, procurement@helioai.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: recommended reserved slice profile for Q3/Q4

Thanks Mina — appreciate the analysis and the clear recommendation. A few notes from our side after a quick look at the CSV: 

- The 62% sustained number tracks with what we see internally. The spikes correlate with model retraining windows and demo days (monthly).
- We want to keep at least ~15–20 GPUs available for sudden exploratory jobs run by research so can’t move everything to reserve.
- Procurement will need a 30-day lead time on contract changes (cc’d).

Questions: 
1) Can you confirm how the reserved slices map to our existing fleet IDs? We run a mix of A100s and H100s and want to keep the newer H100s as reserved where possible.
2) If we do a phased conversion (20 GPUs reserved now, 20 reserved next quarter), can we lock pricing for both phases in a single amendment?

I’m available Tue 20 Jul at 10:30 PT for a quick call.

—Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform Operations, HelioAI
sarah.jenkins@helioai.com | +1 (510) 777-1212

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helioai.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: recommended reserved slice profile for Q3/Q4

Looping in Karthik to confirm capacity mapping and H100 availability. Quick notes before Tue:

- We can map reserved slices to specific host types; Helio currently has 28 H100s and ~32 A100s in the fleet record. We should prioritize H100s for reserved conversion where possible.
- Pricing: we can lock pricing across a two-stage conversion if the amendment specifies tranche dates (e.g., 40 reserved split into 20 now, 20 on 2027-10-01). I’ll attach the pricing workbook for prep.
- Lead times: hardware-specific mapping requires an inventory snapshot at signing. Ops should expect a 7–10 day provisioning window for slice reservation activation after the amendment is fully executed.

Mina — I can run a short slide (2–3 bullets) for the Tue call showing cost delta and failover plan.

Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Pricing_workbook_HEL-2027-087.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helioai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal: recommended reserved slice profile for Q3/Q4

Thanks team — following up from the call. Confirmations and tech details: 

- Inventory snapshot (as of 2027-07-20): 28 H100, 34 A100. We’ll propose reserving 40 units mapped: 28 H100 (all H100s flagged), 12 A100. That keeps 22 A100 as burst pool.
- Failover and spillover: reserved slices are backed by a routing policy that will overflow to burst if utilization hits >92% for >3 continuous minutes. That keeps latency-sensitive traffic protected.
- Telemetry: we’ll enable a per-slice cost tag and a weekly utilization report exported to your Drive folder (link follows).

Next steps I’ll take: create the mapping sheet (which physical GPU ids map to the reservation), update the pricing workbook Ben shared to include phased discount, and hand the draft amendment to procurement. ETA for those artifacts: 3 business days.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/HEL-2027-087/slice-plan
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helioai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@helioai.com
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: recommended reserved slice profile for Q3/Q4 — approved with minor edits

Team —

Thanks for the clear plan and the fast turnaround. Procurement confirmed they can approve the two-tranche amendment with the phased pricing schedule and the H100-first mapping. A couple small asks before we sign: 

- Add a clause for a one-time reprofile after 90 days with no early termination penalty if utilization shifts significantly.
- Confirm the 7–10 day activation window will be measured from DocuSign completion not the invoice date.

If you can drop the updated amendment into the Drive folder and create the DocuSign package we’ll get procurement to sign within 72 hours.

Approved to proceed pending those two edits — Sarah

Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform Operations, HelioAI
sarah.jenkins@helioai.com
